english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to stop / give name / address / report accident involving aircraft / vehicle at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), where an accident involving an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), and the vehicle had occurred you failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a constable through the published airport telephone number as soon as reasonably practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(3)(b) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
